underdog.heading: Why Ball State can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -11.4 to p90 +32.6 for Liberty, so a projection of +11.6 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
